resumos: A binary JSON-compatible format that aims to be more compact and faster to parse than JSON.
Extensão binária do JSON que reduz tamanho e acelera a leitura, mantendo compatibilidade com JSON.
readme:
**NOTE**: This module has become part of [Jackson Binary Dataformats](../../../jackson-dataformats-binary)
as of Jackson 2.8

This repo still exists to allow release of patch versions of older versions; it will be hidden (made private)
in near future.
